records.failureSummary: Implemented and verified escapeHtmlText, escapeAttrUrl and parseInlineLinks in src/render.mjs (only backend file changed). escapeHtmlText escapes & first, then <, >, \" and ', producing & < > " ' without treating pre-existing entities specially (matching the spec's sequential-replace contract). escapeAttrUrl escapes only &, \" and ', leaving < and > untouched, for href attribute values. parseInlineLinks scans text nodes for the literal [text](url) form with a non-greedy, non-nested capture, escapes link text via escapeHtmlText and url via escapeAttrUrl, and emits text with a double-quoted href; all surrounding/non-link text is HTML text escaped, multiple links per line are all replaced, and input order is preserved. The module-scoped regex lastIndex is reset at the start of each call so parsing is stateless and re-entrant. No new dependencies, no url validation, no nested-bracket parsing, and no changes to frontmatter.mjs, renderPage or buildSite. Verified: node --check passes for all src files, npm run lint exits 0, and a focused assertion run of the three helpers passes 7/7. The repository test suite still reports 2 failures that belong to the separate renderPage and buildSite tasks and are out of scope here.
